A MUMBAI STORY. AN OPEN WORLD.

Paper is just
the beginning.

Behind every thoughtful gift, organised desk and bright idea, there’s a world of possibility.

Oasis Bazaar is the online brand and catalogue platform of Om Nidhi Trading Pvt. Ltd., a Mumbai-based paper, stationery, gifting and packaging business with an established offline presence.

We bring together practical essentials and beautifully considered packaging for students, offices, artists, creative studios, retailers and businesses. Discover the range online, then talk to our team about what you need.

A FEW HELPFUL ANSWERS

Good to know.

How do I order or request details?

Choose a product and select Enquire. Add your details and continue to WhatsApp, where our team can confirm availability and help with your request.

Do you supply wholesale orders?

Yes. We welcome retailers, resellers, schools, offices, gifting companies and other businesses. Share your requirements through the wholesale form.

Why aren’t prices shown?

This is our discovery and enquiry catalogue. Contact us for current pricing based on the product, specifications and quantity you require.

What is the minimum order quantity?

Minimum quantities depend on the product. Tell our team which items you need and we’ll confirm the applicable quantity.

Can I enquire about a specific size or finish?

Absolutely. Include your preferred dimensions, colour, finish and quantity. Our team will confirm available options.
